visualFindings: Initial count result and primary controls are visible and readable at1280x720.
Changed-receiver image shows the insufficient result and open-panel controls; detailed witness/source panels are below the viewport and preserved in DOM observations.
Diagram and plain originals show the same six typed relations; the receiver-result line is partly clipped at the top after scrolling.
At960x720 controls wrap without horizontal overflow; selected negative result is visible, while global result and source details require scrolling.
JSON panels use capped internal scroll regions; the plain screenshot shows a scrolled payload region. No human readability or interface advantage measured.
